title: ArgoCD sync failure after Helm upgrade
symptoms: ArgoCD Application status Degraded or Unknown
Sync error: resource validation failed, CRD not found, immutable field change
Pods not updated after Git push
root_cause: Helm chart breaking change; CRD upgrade ordering issue; immutable field modified (Service clusterIP, PVC size); resource conflict with manual kubectl changes
workaround: argocd app sync <app> --force (with approval); helm rollback <release> <revision>; delete conflicting resource if safe
permanent_fix: Pin Helm chart versions; test upgrades in staging; use sync waves for CRD-before-workload ordering; enforce GitOps-only changes (deny manual kubectl in prod)

auto_healing.mechanism: ArgoCD automated sync with self-heal; rollback on failed health check via Argo Rollouts or sync hook

notes: Document sync wave ordering for all platform charts
